title: Canonical CI topology modes and maintenance-pr governance
purpose: Canonicalize integration-head, post-merge and maintenance-pr modes while preserving released product bytes and separating harness topology defects from product evidence.

modes.integration-head: Explicit workflow selection for integration verification using frozen four-parent topology and accepted provenance checks.
modes.post-merge: Explicit workflow selection for main verification using expected two-parent ancestry, accepted integration-head identity and executable-tree checks.
modes.maintenance-pr: Strictly limited to maintenance pull requests of the harness only; never usable for integration heads or post-merge commits. Selection is explicit, never inferred. Missing or unknown mode fails closed.

maintenancePrRequirements: Mode absence or unknown mode fails closed.
The PR base descends from the authorized baseline.
The diff is checked exactly against the maintenance PR allowlist.
Regression tests for integration-head and post-merge modes execute on temporary Git repositories.
Double deterministic build verification is executed.
The complete product test suite is executed.
No control from integration-head or post-merge modes is reduced or altered.
maintenance-pr cannot validate an integration head or a post-merge commit.
sourceManifestRestriction: source_manifest.json may change only to preserve fingerprints and provenance of the other three authorized modified files.
No product source ordering may change.
No published artifact digest may change.
No other use of source_manifest.json is authorized.
invariants: Only the four exact allowed paths may change.
No new file creation, deletion, rename or path substitution is authorized.
Mode selection is explicit and fail-closed.
Topology, provenance, build and product failures remain distinct machine-readable classifications.
The released artifact remains learnit-next.html, 84060 bytes, SHA-256 53ab18a61fdac152117a4c098bfa991c14970334bad00dffc9ae14fc2c1b0ef4.
No product behavior, runtime source, authoring, contract, governance-state or RC718 content changes.
Merge remains held until repository gates, independent QA and governor review pass.
requiredEvidence: The exact four existing authorized paths are reported.
Independent QA reproduces modes, regressions, deterministic builds and product tests.
The governor verifies provenance, scope, artifact identity and classifications.
QA independent review and governor review are mandatory before merge.
adversarialTests: Unknown or missing mode fails closed.
Topology and product failures remain distinct.
Test counts come from execution and not hard-coded totals.
nonGoals: Changing authoring tools, kits, contracts or schemas.
Adding product features or test files.
independentReview: Independent QA reproduces the complete evidence chain.
The governor verifies the canonical scope and evidence before merge.
Merge is prohibited until all gates pass.
rollback: Close the implementation pull request without merge, or revert only the four-path CI correction commit.
